reason: Our fees run in Tally and notices go on WhatsApp, and it works well enough. I am not paying Rs 30,000 to Rs 60,000 a year for software my office staff will not use, and a 14-day trial is no use when nobody has time to enter our data.
objection: Who will train my staff and enter our data? My office staff are not comfortable with computers, and a website signup does not tell me anyone will come to the school to set it up.
would_change_my_mind: Someone visiting the school to load our student and fee data and train the office staff in Hindi, with a principal I know who already uses it, and setup done outside fee collection season.
